item.title: Velvet Jewelry Gift Box with Magnetic Closure & Gold Foil for Ring Packaging
item.description:
Elegant velvet jewelry gift box with magnetic closure and gold hot foil stamping — manufactured by Guangdong Bincai Color Printing Co., Ltd., a full-chain packaging enterprise with 22 years of experience (founded 2003). 10,000 sqm factory with KBA 1050 4-color and Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses. Daily output 1.5 million boxes.

Applications

  • Luxury ring and earring packaging for jewellery brands
  • Necklace and bracelet gift box for retail display
  • Wedding and engagement ring presentation boxes
  • High-end boutique jewellery packaging
  • Custom promotional jewellery sets for corporate gifting

Customization Options

  • Velvet-lined interior in 12+ color options (black, navy, burgundy, cream, etc.)
  • Die-cut foam or velvet insert with precision cavities for rings, earrings, necklaces
  • Gold, silver, or rose gold hot foil stamping for brand logo and text
  • Embossing and debossing for tactile brand elevation
  • Magnetic flap closure with hidden magnet for seamless opening
  • Satin ribbon pull tab for elegant presentation
  • Custom sizes: from compact 50×50×30mm to 250×180×50mm
  • Full CMYK + Pantone spot color printing on outer wrapping paper

Production Specifications

  • KBA 1050 4-color offset press for high-speed precision printing
  • Heidelberg 7+1 UV press for specialty coatings and instant curing
  • Fully automatic rigid box production line with corner wrapping
  • Greyboard thickness: 800gsm–2000gsm for structural rigidity
  • Velvet flocking: 0.8mm–1.5mm pile height for luxury tactile finish
  • ISO 9001:2015 quality management throughout production
  • FSC-certified paper sourcing for sustainable packaging

Quality Details

  • Precision magnetic alignment — flap closes flush every time
  • Velvet adhesive tested for 5+ years durability, no peeling
  • 100% inspection on gold foil stamping registration
  • Drop-tested structure for retail and e-commerce shipping
  • Free pre-production samples with 5–7 day turnaround
  • MOQ 500–1000 units, trial orders and OEM/ODM accepted

Factory

  • 22 years of manufacturing excellence since 2003
  • 10,000 sqm main factory + 8,000 sqm new smart factory (2025)
  • 80+ skilled employees across design, prepress, printing, and finishing
  • KBA 1050 4-color + Heidelberg 7+1 UV presses
  • Fully automatic die-cutting, gluing, and rigid box assembly lines
  • Daily capacity: 1.5 million color boxes + 200,000+ gift boxes
